item.title: Police seize illegal e-bike in Market Harborough
item.description: An e-bike has been seized by police in Market Harborough. Officers were on patrol in the town centre as part of efforts to tackle illegally modified e-bikes and scooters, following complaints about them being ridden dangerously. Police say the seizure is a reminder that bikes being used illegally in public can be confiscated.
